title: 1 Timothy
author: Paul the apostle.
historicalSetting: Paul instructs Timothy concerning doctrine, worship, leadership, and godliness in the church.
keyVerse: 1 Timothy 2:5 — "For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus."
christFocus: First Timothy centers the church on Christ, the one Mediator, and calls leaders to guard doctrine and godliness under His lordship.
